signature.name: VTask.snd
signature.type: {n : ℕ} -> {α β : TypeVec.{u} n} -> (α.prod β).Arrow β

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.snd is a total, recursively well-defined morphism for all n, α, β including n = 0; there are no junk-value or default-value conventions.

facts.statement: example : VTask.snd (n := 1) (α := fun _ => Unit) (β := fun _ => Bool) Fin2.fz (⟨(), true⟩ : Unit × Bool) = true := by decide
